assertions.text: Generate a deterministic inventory of production entrypoints, durable stores, runtime/model/tool/browser paths and map each to exactly one canonical owner or explicit BUILD disposition.
Introduce an unregistered production entrypoint or alternate task/model/effect store and prove the inventory check rejects the unowned path.
Change one tracked ownership input, verify --check detects drift, regenerate, then verify the inventory returns to a deterministic clean state.
Publish one machine-readable ownership map covering every canonical service, authoritative store, event producer and external-effect actuator with no duplicate owner.
Assign the same authoritative state or external effect to two owners and verify ownership validation fails with both conflicting identifiers.
Remove one canonical owner entry, verify dependent wiring becomes invalid, restore the owner and regenerate affected views.

title: Freeze canonical service and state ownership

assertions.text: Validate every registered canonical contract and generate language bindings from the registered schema revision without hand-written competing DTOs.
Add a required field to a hand-written shadow DTO while leaving the schema unchanged and prove the import/contract gate rejects the competing contract.
Regenerate bindings after a compatible schema edit and prove no stale generated binding remains referenced by production code.

title: Install canonical schema and generated-binding gate

assertions.text: Regenerate task graph, inverse requirement links, milestone counts, reading views, support mappings and integrity metadata twice and obtain byte-identical canonical outputs.
Hand-edit a generated task edge or milestone count and prove check mode fails rather than accepting the stale generated view.
Delete one generated view, rerun generation, and prove it is restored solely from canonical registries.
Scan the qualified production tree and fail on reachable incomplete implementation markers while excluding only registered test, fixture, vendor and generated paths.
Place an incomplete production branch behind a reachable API path and prove the scanner fails even when all task metadata claims PASS.
Move the same marker into an isolated test fixture and prove production scanning remains clean without broadening exclusions.

Validate PASS evidence only when the referenced task, exact requirement/assertion set, reachable repository commit, report digest, artifact digests and required real-boundary proof all match actual state.
Submit a report whose outer record says PASS while a blocking assertion says FAIL or whose artifact digest is substituted; both must be rejected.
Record a genuine unavailable external dependency as BLOCKED_REAL_BOUNDARY and prove it remains non-completing until new evidence is produced after the boundary becomes available.
Create decision records that capture owner, context, chosen option, rejected alternatives, affected invariants, threat impact, migration/rollback plan and review trigger.
Attempt to change a canonical owner or effect/security invariant without an accepted decision record and prove CI blocks the change.
Exercise a reversible decision rollback and verify generated ownership/wiring returns to the prior accepted state without orphaned schema or task references.
Provision real relational database, durable event transport, cache/lease store and object/evidence storage with isolated test identities, health checks and teardown.
Replace any required durable boundary with an in-memory fake and prove qualification refuses to mark the environment ready.
Restart each dependency independently and verify health detection, reconnect and teardown leave no falsely passing environment state.
Authenticate a user into one tenant/workspace and prove every emitted command carries server-resolved tenant, user, session and workspace identity.
Modify a client-supplied tenant or user identifier and verify the server ignores/rejects it before any authoritative read or write.
Restart the API process and prove a valid durable session can resume without recreating tenant or user authority from client state.

title: Implement tenant and authenticated session authority

assertions.text: Apply migrations on an empty database and create tenant-scoped tables for identities, agents, runs, graphs, protocol state, approvals, effects, schedules and registries.
Attempt a cross-tenant key/reference insertion and prove database/application constraints reject the invalid ownership.
Upgrade then rollback the latest reversible migration on a production-like copy and verify schema/data invariants and migration history remain consistent.

title: Create authoritative relational schema and migrations

assertions.text: Append events with stable event_id, tenant/workspace/run identity, canonical sequence, causal parents, producer identity, generation and committed timestamp; replay reproduces canonical order.
Submit duplicate event_id or non-monotonic canonical sequence for one run and verify append fails without corrupting replay.
Crash after transaction commit but before client delivery, reconnect from prior cursor, and prove the committed event is delivered exactly as projection data without re-executing work.

title: Implement canonical RuntimeEvent append and replay

assertions.text: Commit authoritative state mutation and its outbox record in one transaction; delivery eventually publishes the exact committed event and marks only that delivery complete.
Force database rollback after outbox preparation and prove no event for the rolled-back mutation appears on the durable event transport.
Crash the publisher after transport publish but before outbox acknowledgement and prove restart redelivery is deduplicated by event identity.
Persist tool calls, approval waits, questions, worker lifecycle, browser/control ownership, cancellation and durable wait state independently of semantic memory.
Delete semantic memory while preserving protocol state and prove an interrupted approval/tool wait can still resume correctly.
Restart runtime during an outstanding question/approval and prove the exact protocol object is restored without creating a duplicate request.
Store an artifact by digest with tenant, media type, producer, size, scan state and grant metadata; refetch returns bytes matching the recorded digest.
Attempt to overwrite an existing digest identity with different bytes and verify storage rejects mutation rather than changing historical evidence.
Restore object metadata from backup and verify all referenced blobs are digest-verified before the restored artifact becomes readable.

title: Implement immutable artifact and evidence storage

assertions.text: Use cache only for leases, bounded acceleration and ephemeral coordination while every recoverable task/approval/effect remains reconstructible without cache contents.
Flush the complete cache during active non-effect work and verify no canonical task, approval or event truth is lost or rewritten.
Restart cache and verify leases/generations are safely reacquired or invalidated from authoritative state before execution resumes.

title: Constrain cache and lease store to non-authoritative use

assertions.text: Execute canonical repository queries under two tenants and prove identical object identifiers cannot cross tenant scope through list, get, update or event projection.
Inject a foreign tenant identifier into direct repository parameters and verify access is denied before data materialization.
Recover from database failover and rerun isolation probes to prove connection reestablishment does not drop tenant filters.
Create, version and resume a WorkGraph whose nodes, edges, dependencies, deadlines and state are persisted and mutated only by GraphTransaction.
Attempt a direct node-state update outside GraphTransaction and prove the repository/runtime guard rejects it.
Crash between two graph transitions and prove replay resumes from the last committed transaction without duplicating completed nodes.
Create a persistent teammate and an ephemeral worker with distinct lifecycle, owner, workspace binding and immutable admitted capability snapshot.
Attempt to reuse an expired ephemeral worker identity as a persistent teammate and verify lifecycle validation rejects the transition.
Restart runtime while a persistent teammate is idle and prove identity/workspace binding survives while expired ephemeral state is cleaned safely.
Apply a multi-object graph transition atomically and emit the corresponding RuntimeEvent only after all state preconditions succeed.
Force one precondition failure in a multi-object transaction and verify no partial graph/agent/state mutation or event remains committed.
Crash after database commit before projection delivery and prove transaction identity prevents a second state mutation during recovery.
Reserve worker capacity, budget and child capability atomically before exposing a worker dispatch; child authority is a strict subset of the parent.
Request a child capability or budget ceiling above the parent allowance and verify admission fails before worker visibility or resource consumption.
Crash after reservation but before dispatch and prove recovery either completes the original admission once or releases the orphaned reservation.
Dispatch at least 32 child turns, persist each dispatch and incremental outcome independently, and aggregate partial/final results without blocking parent lifecycle.
Deliver one child result twice and another after its deadline; verify deduplication and deadline semantics do not corrupt aggregate state.
Disconnect all clients while children complete, then reconnect and prove completed outcomes appear from durable state without child re-execution.
Cancel a parent with queued, running and already-effect-committed children; prevent queued starts, request running cancellation and preserve committed effect history.
Attempt to mark a committed external effect as rolled back solely because its parent was cancelled and verify the state transition is rejected.
Restart during cancellation and prove every child reaches an explicit terminal/cancellation state without replaying committed effects.
Race at least 32 concurrent reservations against one parent ceiling and prove accepted reservations plus committed usage never exceed the available parent budget.
Retry the same reservation idempotency key and submit a stale-generation reservation; duplicate spend and stale admission must both be rejected.
Cancel work before final provider usage arrives and prove the reservation remains settling until late usage is applied exactly once and unused amount is released.
Suspend a graph on timer, approval and external callback waits without holding a process and resume each from a durable wait identity.
Deliver the same callback twice and an expired callback after cancellation; verify only the first valid callback advances the graph.
Restart runtime and event transport during a pending wait and prove the graph resumes exactly once when the wait condition later becomes true.
Route every production model request from API/runtime through the model gateway and prove clients, guests, tools, skills and connectors contain no provider credential path.
Enable a direct provider call from a worker/tool code path and prove source/import/runtime policy gates reject that route.
Restart the gateway during an admitted request and return a typed interruption/retry outcome without transferring credential custody elsewhere.

title: Establish model gateway as exclusive fulfillment boundary

assertions.text: Translate one enabled provider profile into canonical request, stream, usage and terminal events while keeping provider-specific fields inside the adapter boundary.
Return a provider payload with missing mandatory identity/usage fields and prove the adapter emits a typed protocol failure rather than fabricating values.
Disable the adapter during an in-flight request and verify gateway state reaches an explicit terminal outcome and reservations remain reconcilable.
Select an allowed model profile from capability demand, policy, residency, context, availability and budget using a versioned deterministic route decision.
Remove all candidates satisfying residency or budget constraints and verify routing fails explicitly without making a prerequisite model call.
Change catalog availability between retry attempts and prove the recorded routing version plus retry policy prevents silent route drift for an already admitted step.
Emit MODEL_STARTED followed by ordered deltas/tool proposals/usage and exactly one terminal event while respecting consumer backpressure.
Inject duplicate sequence, pre-start delta and post-terminal delta; each invalid stream condition must be rejected or normalized without reaching runtime as valid events.
Cancel during blocked downstream consumption and prove provider cancellation, terminal MODEL_CANCELLED and reservation settlement complete without deadlock.

title: Implement canonical streaming, cancellation and backpressure

assertions.text: Reserve usage before provider start, apply streamed/final usage idempotently, and release unused reservation only after usage finality.
Deliver the same late charge twice after cancellation and verify the second delivery produces no additional spend; an over-ceiling adjustment triggers policy handling.
Recover from gateway restart with SETTLING_PROVIDER_USAGE records and complete append-only adjustments without rewriting earlier settlement history.

title: Implement usage reservation and late settlement

assertions.text: Classify request context before provider egress and enforce allow/redact/deny/residency policy with auditable policy decision identity.
Place protected content in prompt/context for a denied destination and prove captured outbound bytes contain zero protected content.
Restart policy dependency during admission and fail closed until a valid current decision is obtained; do not send while decision state is unknown.

title: Implement model privacy and residency enforcement

assertions.text: Convert timeout, rate-limit, malformed response and provider outage into typed outcomes and use only policy-allowed failover candidates.
Trigger failover after a tool proposal/effect boundary has already committed and prove the gateway cannot silently replay the committed external effect.
Restore a provider after outage and verify health re-entry requires fresh probe state before it becomes routable.

title: Implement provider failure isolation and failover

assertions.text: Execute real request, streaming, cancellation, usage, malformed-response handling and outage/failover tests for the enabled profile and bind results to exact adapter/config artifacts.
Run the qualification with real_boundary=false or without actual provider response evidence and verify completion evidence is rejected.
Repeat the suite after gateway restart and confirm result/usage identities remain reproducible and no stale request is resumed as a new charge.

title: Qualify enabled model profile at real boundary

assertions.text: Validate and execute programs using only SEARCH, RETRIEVE, FAN_OUT, FILTER, RANK, DEDUPLICATE, JOIN, EXTRACT, RESOLVE_ENTITY, VERIFY, ITERATE and SYNTHESIZE with typed arguments and bounded budgets.
Submit executable predicate text, unknown operator, fan-out above 1000 or iteration above 20 and verify validation fails before network/tool execution.
Restart during a multi-stage program and resume from durable operator outputs without repeating completed retrieval/effect-free steps unnecessarily.
Retrieve sources with canonical source identity, retrieval timestamp, freshness metadata, access status, content digest and deduplication key.
Return two URLs/documents resolving to the same canonical content/entity and verify duplicate candidates are merged without losing distinct provenance.
When a source becomes inaccessible, preserve prior provenance as stale/inaccessible rather than claiming fresh verification.

title: Implement retrieval adapters and source provenance

assertions.text: Produce records separating canonical entity identity, attributes, claims, source references, freshness, confidence and verification state.
Merge two different entities with similar names and verify identity constraints/evidence detect the false merge before final synthesis.
Correct an entity identity after new evidence and preserve superseded identity evidence without silently rewriting prior records.
Discover and enrich at least 100 candidates using bounded parallel fan-out, joins, deduplication and durable intermediate result sets under explicit cost/time limits.
Force one retrieval branch to exceed budget and another to time out; verify bounded partial completion and explicit missing-data status rather than unbounded retries.
Restart context/runtime mid-research and continue from persisted intermediate sets while preserving operator provenance and budget state.

title: Implement wide and deep research execution

assertions.text: Independently refetch cited sources and classify each claim as supported, unsupported, stale, inaccessible or conflicting with evidence references.
Alter a synthesized claim while keeping its citation unchanged and verify support scoring fails the claim rather than trusting citation presence.
When refetch transitions from accessible to inaccessible, retain the last evidence digest and mark verification state accordingly without fabricating freshness.

title: Implement independent claim and source verification

assertions.text: Build task-scoped model context from canonical history, knowledge, tool outputs and evidence under token/data/capability limits with projection version identity.
Request context from a forbidden tenant/data class or exceed projection budget and verify protected material is omitted/denied before model request construction.
Invalidate a source epoch and rebuild projection without changing canonical transcript, protocol state or recovery state.
Ingest, update and tombstone indexed material with source revision, chunk provenance and freshness watermark; queries exclude tombstoned content by default.
Delete a source without publishing a tombstone and verify freshness validation detects index/source divergence.
Rebuild the index from authoritative source/artifact metadata and prove query identity/freshness semantics remain consistent after index loss.

title: Implement index freshness and tombstone semantics

assertions.text: Run a sealed benchmark and achieve discovery recall >=0.90, entity precision >=0.95, claim precision >=0.95, citation support >=0.98, freshness >=0.98, duplicate rate <=0.02 and hard completion >=0.85.
Change scorer formula, dataset digest or source policy without updating qualification identity and prove the result is rejected as non-comparable.
Re-run scoring from preserved benchmark outputs and obtain identical metric values within declared deterministic tolerance.

Persist an immutable CapabilitySnapshot with capability atoms, target/data constraints, expiry, parent reference and revision; prove child snapshots are strict subsets before any worker/model/tool/machine admission.
Attempt child capability escalation or post-admission snapshot mutation and verify both are denied before the requested execution becomes externally visible.
Expire a snapshot during a durable wait and prove resumed work requires fresh admission before any further protected or consequential execution.
Evaluate actor, semantic operation, normalized arguments, target, data classification and capability snapshot into a versioned PolicyDecision.
Reuse an allow decision after changing one normalized consequential argument and prove scope digest mismatch blocks execution.
When policy service recovers from outage, require a fresh decision for pending consequential work rather than accepting unknown/stale policy.
Classify outbound model, connector, upload and remote-worker data and apply allow/redact/approval/deny before bytes leave the trusted boundary.
Attempt a denied secret/PII transfer through an alternate connector/browser upload route and prove all egress paths use the same classification decision.
Recover classifier dependency and re-evaluate pending egress against current policy instead of replaying a stale allow.
Issue short-lived credential handles bound to tenant, operation, target, expiry and capability without returning reusable plaintext credentials to clients/guests.
Replay an expired handle or use it for a different target/operation and verify broker refusal before external authentication.
Rotate underlying credentials while a handle is outstanding and ensure invalidated handles fail cleanly while new handles use the rotated secret.
Evaluate canonical event/effect history so a configured dangerous sequence can block or escalate the next operation before actuation.
Perform allowed secret read followed by disallowed outbound upload sequence and verify the upload is blocked despite both operation types being independently valid in isolation.
After policy/rule update, re-evaluate pending sequence state deterministically without deleting historical events.
Create EffectRecord before every consequential actuation and persist proposal, policy, approval, execution, outcome, receipt and evidence correlation.
Invoke a consequential connector/browser operation without effect_id and verify actuator/broker rejects it before external call.
Restart runtime during EXECUTING and reconcile the same effect identity rather than issuing a new effect on recovery.
Persist approval request and receipt bound to exact operation/effect/target/normalized scope, including payee, amount, currency and ceilings for financial effects.
Change approved amount by one minor currency unit or substitute payee while retaining the receipt and prove denial occurs before provider invocation.
Disconnect approving client, approve from another authorized surface, and resume exactly the waiting effect without duplicate approval/effect creation.
On ambiguous timeout mark the effect UNKNOWN and query provider/target idempotency state before deciding COMMITTED, FAILED or safe retry.
Retry an UNKNOWN effect blindly without reconciliation and verify the effect engine blocks the second actuation.
Restart reconciliation worker mid-query and continue with the same effect/idempotency identity until an explicit reconciled terminal outcome is recorded.
Register execution targets with tenant, type, lifecycle state, execution generation, support profile and health identity; lifecycle transitions are durable and auditable.
Attempt to dispatch work to an unregistered, wrong-tenant or disabled support target and verify placement rejects it before lease acquisition.
Recover machine-control after restart and reconstruct target state from authoritative inventory/heartbeats without trusting stale in-memory ownership.
Acquire an exclusive lease and fence token for a target generation before dispatch; every guest/endpoint action validates all three.
Submit an action with stale generation, expired lease or prior fence token and verify rejection before guest actuation.
Expire the lease during controller crash, reacquire with higher fence/generation as required, and prove the old controller can no longer act.

title: Implement exclusive placement, lease and fence

assertions.text: Execute filesystem, terminal, process and browser/computer guest operations through versioned typed RPC with bounded inputs/outputs and task-scoped capability handles.
Send an unknown operation version, protected path write or ambient-secret request and verify guest rejects it before touching the resource.
Restart qworkerd during a non-effect operation and reconnect using target/generation identity without granting broader authority.
Deliver action envelopes with delivery_id, attempt, idempotency key and expiry; ACK only after the canonical result is durably recorded.
Drop the ACK after successful execution and redeliver the envelope; verify the worker returns the original result without re-executing the operation.
Restart worker-gateway with unacknowledged deliveries and prove redelivery respects expiry, generation and idempotency.

title: Implement durable worker delivery, ACK and redelivery

assertions.text: Provision an isolated per-task environment with tenant-bound identity, deny-by-default internal networking, controlled egress and no long-lived provider credentials.
Attempt internal-network access or unbrokered external credential use outside policy and verify the environment blocks the request.
Destroy and recreate the isolated runtime from declared workspace/artifact inputs and prove no undeclared guest-local state is required for task recovery.
Bind a persistent workspace computer to its owner/workspace independently of client/session lifetime and preserve authorized files/browser state across hibernation.
Attach the workspace to a different tenant/user without an authorized transfer and verify machine-control refuses the binding.
Hibernate, restart control services and resume the workspace while preserving identity and advancing execution generation where required.
Create workspace-only and full-machine checkpoints whose referenced database/event/artifact state is durably committed and digest-verified before RESTORABLE.
Mark a checkpoint restorable while one referenced artifact is missing or one state watermark is uncommitted and verify qualification rejects it.
Restore/migrate to a new generation and prove stale pre-restore actions fail lease/fence/generation validation.

title: Implement checkpoint, snapshot, restore and migration

assertions.text: Register a private worker target and execute the same typed command/capability/effect/evidence protocol used by hosted targets without a separate runtime.
Attempt to enable a private target without its mapped qualification suites and verify support selection keeps it disabled.
Disconnect the private target, preserve pending work, then reconnect or re-place safely according to operation/effect idempotency.
Create a durable managed browser session bound to workspace/target with structured control channels, observation stream and viewer/controller state.
Attach a viewer/controller from another tenant or stale session generation and verify access is denied before browser state is exposed.
Restart client/browser-control process and reconnect to the same qualified session when session health permits without silently creating a new session identity.
Navigate, query, click, type, select and extract using structured page/accessibility/network state where available and correlate observations to run/step/session.
Target an element using stale page identity after navigation and verify the action is rejected/re-resolved instead of clicking an unrelated target.
When structured state becomes unavailable, enter explicit degraded observation mode and recover to structured control without changing browser session identity.

title: Implement structured browser actions and observation

assertions.text: Classify low-level input by semantic outcome so send, publish, purchase, delete, account change or protected upload enters policy/approval/Effect Ledger before actuator execution.
Attempt to submit a purchase or message using a generic click/type primitive without an EffectRecord and verify browser-control refuses to actuate.
After approval/policy wait, revalidate page/session/operation scope before resuming and refuse if the semantic target changed.

title: Enforce semantic effect classification for browser actions

assertions.text: Expose the live session with explicit viewer/controller identity and allow authorized human takeover and return of control without restarting browser or losing task context.
Let agent and human attempt control simultaneously and prove controller lease serializes actuation and exposes ownership state in UI/runtime.
Disconnect the human controller unexpectedly and transition through bounded takeover-release policy before agent control can resume.
Upload/download files only through artifact records and scoped grants, recording source/target digest, scan state and browser session correlation.
Attempt upload from an arbitrary host path or unscanned/unauthorized artifact and verify transfer is denied before browser file selection.
Interrupt a download, resume/retry with artifact identity, and verify final bytes match digest without duplicate external effects.
Dispatch endpoint actions containing endpoint/target identity, execution generation, lease, fence, capability, policy, effect, delivery/idempotency, operation version and expiry.
Remove fence/generation or alter an approval-bound argument and prove endpoint rejects before actuation.
Drop response delivery after endpoint execution, reconnect and return the original result for the same idempotency key without repeating the action.
Store structured observations and selected visual evidence with session/step/target identity, timestamps and digests while separating observations from effect truth.
Replay an observation as though it were a command/result capable of re-actuation and verify consumers treat it as evidence only.
Recover after evidence-store outage by preserving canonical action/result state and backfilling missing eligible evidence without rerunning the action.
Run real navigation, structured action, consequential-action classification, takeover, reconnect, file-transfer and stale-envelope tests for every enabled profile.
Attempt to enable a profile lacking one mapped blocking test or real-boundary proof and verify support validation keeps it disabled.
Repeat qualification after browser/endpoint process restart and confirm durable session/action identities remain consistent.

title: Qualify enabled browser and endpoint profiles

assertions.text: Create candidates with provenance, evidence references, source epoch, confidence, validity interval, conflict set and producer/run identity before durable acceptance.
Submit a candidate with missing provenance/evidence or authority outside its source scope and verify qualification rejects it.
When source evidence is withdrawn/tombstoned, retain candidate history and update validity/conflict state rather than deleting provenance.
Tag asynchronous synthesis with source/task epochs and accept only when all relevant epochs still match at commit time.
Change/fork/revert the source task while synthesis is running and prove the stale result cannot enter active knowledge.
Restart synthesis worker and recompute from current epoch while preserving the rejected stale attempt as diagnostic evidence.
Store/query enterprise, user-authorized, research, successful-work and engineering knowledge through one versioned fabric with tenant/source/evidence scope.
Try to recover a run solely from Knowledge Fabric after deleting protocol/checkpoint state and verify recovery refuses rather than treating memory as canonical state.
Reindex/rebuild knowledge projections from durable candidates/evidence and preserve canonical source identities across projection loss.
Convert authoritative documents/procedures/examples into candidate SkillPackages with declared purpose, inputs, outputs, instructions, dependencies and source scope.
Create a candidate from untrusted/unscoped material or omit intended-use/exclusion metadata and verify intake keeps it unqualified.
Update source material and create a new candidate version while preserving provenance and keeping the prior qualified version available until promotion decision.

title: Implement controlled skill intake and reconstruction

assertions.text: Analyze candidate package for schema validity, forbidden authority expansion, unsafe helper behavior, protected paths, network needs and declared tool/capability usage.
Embed a helper that attempts undeclared network/credential access or self-promotion and verify evaluation blocks promotion.
After evaluator update, re-evaluate affected candidate versions without silently changing already-recorded evaluation evidence.

title: Implement static and security skill evaluation

assertions.text: Run candidate skill cases in isolated task runtimes with declared capabilities and compare outputs/effects/evidence to versioned thresholds and regressions.
Make the candidate pass only when a mock external boundary is substituted for a required real boundary and verify qualification remains blocked.
Crash evaluation runtime mid-case and resume/restart the case with clean isolation so partial state cannot fabricate a pass.

title: Implement isolated skill execution and regression evaluation

assertions.text: Promote only evaluated versions into the registry with compatibility, thresholds, promotion state and rollback target; promotion is separate from candidate execution.
Let a skill attempt to mutate its own promotion/capability state and prove the runtime/registry denies the operation.
Rollback an active skill version and verify new tasks resolve the prior qualified version while already-running tasks retain their admitted version identity.

title: Implement skill registry, promotion and rollback

assertions.text: Resolve only qualified task-required skills, materialize them into the target under the admitted capability snapshot, and record exact versions in run evidence.
Request an unqualified/incompatible skill or one requiring capability beyond the task snapshot and verify materialization is denied.
After task/target teardown remove task-scoped skill materialization while durable registry/evidence remains intact.
Validate a pack containing identity/version, knowledge/skill/tool/connector requirements, RBAC, policy, approvals, workflows, I/O, evidence, evaluations, compatibility and lifecycle metadata.
Omit evaluation thresholds, required RBAC/policy binding or compatibility metadata and verify the pack cannot reach publishable state.
Load a prior compatible pack version during rollback and preserve installed dependency/evidence identities.
Ingest authoritative enterprise material and produce a candidate compilation model separating entities, rules, permissions, procedures, inputs/outputs and evidence sources.
Feed contradictory or insufficiently authoritative material and verify the compiler emits explicit unresolved conflicts rather than inventing business rules.
Update one source and recompile incrementally while preserving source-to-output provenance and invalidating affected candidate components.

title: Implement capability compiler intake and semantic decomposition

assertions.text: Reconstruct business steps, decisions, roles, approvals and failure paths, then bind reusable qualified skills and WorkGraph templates without creating a separate executor.
Generate a workflow requiring a permission/approval absent from source policy and verify compilation keeps it unresolved/unpublishable.
Change a process dependency and regenerate only affected workflow/skill references while preserving stable identities for unaffected components.

title: Implement process reconstruction and skill/workflow extraction

assertions.text: Resolve every operation to a versioned ToolOperation, required capability, role/permission, policy/approval rule and evidence requirement without embedding credentials.
Attempt to bind a tool whose fidelity/effect class cannot meet the pack acceptance contract or whose required permission is unresolved; publication must fail.
Rotate connector/tool version and re-run compatibility/evaluation before the pack can select the new binding.

title: Bind tools, RBAC, policy and evidence to capability packs

assertions.text: Execute declared evaluation cases through canonical runtime/effect/evidence paths and publish only when every mandatory threshold/dependency/support condition passes.
Force one high-risk negative evaluation to fail while aggregate score remains high and verify mandatory-case failure prevents publication.
Rollback the published pack to its declared rollback target and verify new executions resolve the rollback version without corrupting historical run evidence.

title: Qualify and publish business capability packs

assertions.text: Register each tool operation with schema/version, semantic effect class, fidelity class, capability/policy needs, timeout/idempotency and evidence contract.
Register a consequential operation as harmless or a degrading operation as lossless and verify registry/evaluation policy rejects the unsafe declaration.
Deprecate an operation version and keep admitted running steps pinned while new admissions resolve only supported compatible versions.

title: Implement canonical Tool Registry and fidelity contract

assertions.text: Execute connector operations through credential handles, ToolOperation, policy/privacy/approval/effect mediation and return normalized receipts/evidence.
Invoke the connector adapter directly with reusable secret material or without EffectRecord for a consequential operation and prove the path is unreachable/rejected.
On ambiguous connector timeout create UNKNOWN effect and reconcile using connector idempotency/provider state before retry.
Authenticate webhook source, normalize event identity, deduplicate delivery and correlate accepted ingress to tenant/tool/work initiation before creating work.
Replay the same webhook and submit one with invalid source authentication; duplicate must not create work and invalid source must be rejected.
Crash after durable ingress record but before work creation and resume exactly once from the recorded webhook identity.
Persist timezone, local schedule rule, next-fire calculation and logical fire identity; test normal dates plus daylight-time gap/fold cases using explicit policy.
Create an ambiguous local-time schedule without a declared fold/gap rule and verify validation refuses activation.
Restart scheduler across a clock transition and prove each logical occurrence has at most one accepted fire identity.
Implement SKIP, FIRE_ONCE and CATCH_UP_BOUNDED with an explicit maximum and durable history of logical occurrences.
Simulate prolonged outage producing more missed occurrences than the catch-up bound and verify excess work is not emitted silently.
Recover scheduler after outage and prove emitted catch-up fires retain original logical identities and cannot duplicate on a second restart.

title: Implement missed-fire and bounded catch-up policy

assertions.text: At fire time resolve current support status, capability, policy, credential availability and target health before admitting the WorkGraph.
Revoke a permission after schedule creation but before fire and verify the fire is blocked/attention-required rather than using stale authority.
Restore authority later and follow the configured missed-fire policy rather than replaying an unauthorized original execution.

title: Re-evaluate authority on every automation fire

assertions.text: Persist automation state transitions and serialize pause/resume/delete against scheduler claiming so a logical fire cannot race into duplicate execution.
Pause at the same instant as scheduler claim and prove exactly one defined outcome occurs according to transaction order.
Restart scheduler after delete and prove deleted automation cannot reappear from stale cache/lease state.

title: Implement durable pause, resume and delete semantics

assertions.text: Represent teammate rooms/groups/threads as participants and typed WorkGraph turn/message relations over canonical agents/runtime rather than a second scheduler.
Attempt to add a collaboration-specific execution queue that can mutate task state independently and verify ownership/import checks reject it.
Restart collaboration clients while worker turns continue and rebuild the complete collaboration projection from canonical events/results.
Persist handoff/message identity, sender, recipients, target turn/work item, payload/artifact refs, capability context and delivery outcome.
Deliver the same handoff twice or target a cancelled/unauthorized worker and verify no duplicate work/admission occurs.
Recover after delivery interruption and either complete the same delivery once or expose a durable failed/cancelled outcome.

title: Implement durable typed handoff and message contracts

assertions.text: Create notification/attention records from canonical events with recipient, channel class, urgency, expiry, deep-link target and delivery receipts without owning approval truth.
Replay a notification delivery or acknowledge it from the wrong tenant and verify idempotent/tenant-safe behavior.
Recover notification service after outage and deliver eligible pending notifications without changing the underlying task/approval state.

title: Implement durable attention and notification delivery

assertions.text: Bind routines to persistent teammate identity and schedule/work templates while resolving current capabilities and workspace on each fire.
Delete/disable the teammate before routine fire and verify no orphan routine starts under stale agent identity.
Restore service after missed routine windows and apply the routine missed-fire policy with durable logical-fire identities.
Deliver a desktop workbench with teammate/task/research/capability/automation navigation, central canonical timeline, attention/evidence side panel and artifact/live-workspace pane.
Disconnect the API/event stream and verify the shell shows explicit offline/degraded state without allowing local UI state to claim task completion.
Reconnect from the last durable cursor and rebuild visible state without duplicating messages, effects or approvals.

title: Implement desktop workbench shell and navigation

assertions.text: Apply snapshot plus ordered RuntimeEvent cursor to render run/worker/tool/model/effect/approval states consistently across two client instances.
Inject duplicate and out-of-order delivery and verify clients converge to identical canonical projection without locally inventing sequence.
Clear local client cache, reload and prove the complete visible state reconstructs from server snapshot/events.

title: Implement canonical event timeline and client convergence

assertions.text: Render the existing live session with observation state, target/session identity, viewer/controller lease and takeover/return controls without browser restart.
Attempt control while another actor holds the controller lease and verify UI cannot send actuator commands as though it owned control.
Recover from pane/network disconnect and reattach to the same healthy session or expose explicit ended/degraded state.
Display operation, target, consequential arguments, data class, financial scope where applicable, reason and expiry from the canonical ApprovalRequest and submit the exact request identity.
Change the underlying effect scope after UI render and prove approval submission is rejected or refreshed rather than authorizing hidden changed arguments.
Resolve approval on another authorized client and update the first client from canonical events without a second approval action.
List and open task artifacts/evidence using server grants, showing provenance, digest, producer, scan/freshness status and related claim/effect/run identities.
Attempt to open an artifact from another tenant or expired grant and verify no bytes/metadata beyond permitted denial context are exposed.
Refresh after object-service interruption and restore artifact view from canonical metadata without claiming unavailable bytes were verified.
Run the web surface against the same command/event contracts as desktop and demonstrate cross-client convergence for task, approval and research states.
Add a web-only local task mutation and verify client architecture/import tests reject shadow authority.
Reconnect web after offline period and catch up from cursor without restarting server-side work.

title: Implement web client on canonical commands and events

assertions.text: Implement mobile task status, notifications, approval, questions and supported handoff/takeover surfaces using canonical APIs/events only.
Attempt an unsupported machine/effect action from mobile and verify capability/support gating hides or rejects the action rather than approximating it locally.
Resume a task viewed on another client and prove mobile state converges from server without changing execution ownership.

title: Implement mobile attention and continuation client

assertions.text: Provide authenticated commands for task start/status/cancel, approval response, artifact/evidence lookup and event follow using canonical schemas.
Attempt to invoke a local model/runtime/effect shortcut from the CLI and verify the package contains no alternate execution authority.
Interrupt event follow and resume from stored cursor, receiving only missing canonical events.
Correlate command, session, run, step, model request, tool operation, effect, worker, target and recovery identities across logs, metrics and traces without leaking protected content.
Remove run/effect correlation from one service boundary and verify observability conformance fails the trace completeness check.
Restart telemetry backend and ensure product execution continues with bounded buffering/degradation while missing telemetry is explicitly measurable.
Measure authenticated command/event availability, admission latency, event projection lag and machine readiness using production-like probes and declared exclusion rules.
Hide failed requests behind retries or exclude an unregistered failure class and verify SLO calculation tests reject the manipulated measurement.
Recover metrics pipeline from outage and preserve the outage as missing/failed observation rather than backfilling artificial success.
Create a recovery point binding database commit position, canonical event sequence, evidence manifest digest, snapshot inventory digest, effect-settlement watermark and unresolved UNKNOWN effect IDs.
Attempt to declare recovery consistent using database restore alone while referenced evidence/snapshot/effect watermark differs; verification must fail.
Restore all bound components to a compatible recovery point and reconcile UNKNOWN effects before reopening consequential execution.
Execute destructive restore drills demonstrating authoritative-state RPO <=300s/RTO <=1800s and evidence/object RPO <=900s/RTO <=3600s.
Provide a restore report missing one RecoveryConsistencyPoint component and verify DR qualification fails despite database availability.
After restore, replay/reconcile to current safe state and prove committed effects are not duplicated.
Run sustained concurrent task/model/research/event load and demonstrate declared latency/readiness objectives without unbounded queues or tenant starvation.
Overload one dependency and verify bounded admission/backpressure/degradation rather than silent drops, uncontrolled retries or cross-tenant resource theft.
Return dependency capacity and prove queues/reservations settle without a retry storm or duplicate effect execution.

title: Qualify load, soak and degradation behavior

assertions.text: Enforce per-tenant budgets/quotas for model, research fan-out, workers, storage and connector usage with auditable reservation/settlement.
Race two tenants against a shared capacity limit and prove one tenant cannot consume another tenant’s reserved budget/quota.
Recover quota service after restart from authoritative reservations/settlements without resetting spend counters.

title: Implement tenant quota and cost controls

assertions.text: Probe APIs, events, artifacts, model context, connectors, workers, machines and client cursors for cross-tenant isolation using distinct tenant fixtures.
Attempt identifier substitution, stale grant reuse and cursor replay across tenants and require denial before protected data/effect execution.
Repeat probes after database/cache/service failover to prove recovery paths preserve tenant enforcement.
Bind qualified source commit, dependency locks, generated bindings, service/client artifacts, container/image/config digests and migrations into a reproducible candidate input set.
Substitute one artifact while retaining its filename or use generated bindings from another commit and prove provenance validation fails.
Rebuild from the same qualified inputs and compare declared reproducibility fields; any permitted nondeterminism must be explicitly identified and excluded from semantic identity.
Run persistent teammate work with at least 32 asynchronous workers, client disconnect, partial results, cancellation and restart while preserving canonical graph/event identities.
Inject duplicate worker results and stale client commands; verify no duplicate work/effects and canonical projection remains consistent.
Kill client/runtime processes during active work, restart and complete from durable state without replaying committed effects.

title: Qualify persistent teammate and worker vertical

assertions.text: Execute enabled model profile through routing, privacy, streaming, cancellation, usage reservation/settlement and failover under real boundary conditions.
Attempt direct provider access and protected egress denial case; direct path must be unreachable and denied payload must emit zero protected bytes.
Restart gateway during settling usage and complete idempotent late settlement without double charge.
Run the sealed wide/deep benchmark through SearchProgram and meet every declared recall/precision/citation/freshness/duplicate/completion threshold.
Alter a cited claim or scorer identity after run and verify independent verification or benchmark binding rejects the result.
Resume an interrupted benchmark from durable intermediate state and reproduce final scoring within declared tolerance.
Execute approval-bound message/publication/financial effects and verify exact semantic scope, policy, Effect Ledger, receipt and evidence.
Change financial amount by one minor unit, change payee, or disguise a consequential browser submit as generic input; all must be denied before actuator/provider call.
Force ambiguous timeout, restart effect worker, reconcile UNKNOWN and prove at-most-once consequential outcome.

title: Qualify protected and financial effect vertical

assertions.text: Provision isolated and persistent targets, execute typed guest/browser actions, human takeover, endpoint relay, checkpoint/restore and stale-generation fencing.
Replay old fence/generation after restore and attempt unqualified support target; both must be blocked before actuation.
Disconnect worker/browser/client surfaces, restore service and prove safe reconnect/redelivery without duplicate effect.

title: Qualify machine, browser and endpoint vertical

assertions.text: Ingest authoritative material, evaluate/promote a skill, compile/evaluate/publish a Business Capability Pack and execute it through canonical runtime/tools/effects/evidence.
Inject an authority-expanding skill or capability with unresolved RBAC/tool fidelity and prove promotion/publication fails.
Rollback skill and capability versions and verify new work resolves rollback targets while historical run evidence remains version-pinned.

title: Qualify skill and business capability vertical

assertions.text: Exercise timezone/DST/missed-fire routines while desktop, web, mobile and CLI observe/respond to the same task/approval event stream.
Inject duplicate logical fire and out-of-order client events; verify one work admission and convergent client projections.
Restart scheduler and all clients, then resume from canonical fire history/event cursors without duplicate work.
Perform production-like recovery using a RecoveryConsistencyPoint and meet declared RPO/RTO while preserving event/artifact/snapshot/effect consistency.
Restore database to a point inconsistent with effect/evidence watermark and prove the system refuses production reopen.
Complete reconciliation after restore and verify no committed external effect is replayed and unresolved UNKNOWN effects are handled before new consequential work.

title: Qualify disaster recovery and effect consistency

assertions.text: Create a candidate identity binding exact source commit, generated bindings, service/client artifacts, images/configuration, migrations and support selection.
Change any bound artifact/config/source after candidate creation and verify the modified set has a different candidate identity and cannot reuse prior qualification.
Re-materialize the candidate from stored artifact identities and verify every digest/config/migration matches before qualification begins.
Run every blocking suite mapped to enabled support profiles against the exact candidate and record candidate-bound reports with all blocking assertions PASS.
Substitute a report from another candidate or omit one mapped suite and verify candidate cannot become CANDIDATE_QUALIFIED.
Resume interrupted qualification without rebuilding candidate and retain completed suite evidence only when candidate/config identities still match.
Deploy the exact CANDIDATE_QUALIFIED artifacts/config/migrations to canary and record deployment identity, cohort, health and post-deploy checks.
Attempt canary using rebuilt/unqualified artifact or unsupported enabled profile and verify deployment gate refuses promotion.
Recover a failed canary deployment by executing the declared rollback without altering the candidate evidence record.
Execute rollback from canary under live representative traffic and prove schema/data/effect compatibility, no duplicate effects and restored service health.
Introduce an irreversible migration without declared expand/contract rollback path and verify rollback qualification fails before GO decision.
After rollback restore canary to the same qualified candidate and rerun post-deploy checks without changing candidate identity.

title: Prove canary rollback and data/effect compatibility

assertions.text: Evaluate exact candidate suite results, SLO/security/DR/canary/rollback evidence and support selection into an explicit GO_APPROVED or NO_GO decision.
Force one blocking suite/report to FAIL after aggregation and verify GO_APPROVED becomes invalid rather than relying on aggregate majority.
Re-evaluate after a corrected new candidate; prior decision remains immutable and cannot be reassigned to the new candidate.

title: Record independent go or no-go decision

assertions.text: Create a digest-bound readiness bundle containing candidate identity, all blocking reports, support selection, canary, rollback, SLO/security/DR results and GO decision; state becomes READINESS_EVIDENCE_SEALED only.
Remove or substitute one blocking report after bundle creation and verify bundle integrity/readiness validation fails.
Reconstruct the bundle from immutable references and reproduce its digest without changing candidate release state.
Verify release-state policy allows only GATE-M14 to write PRODUCTION_READY after READINESS_EVIDENCE_SEALED and all gate dependencies pass.
Attempt to have REL-006, a client, deployment script or administrator API write PRODUCTION_READY and verify state authority rejects it.
Restart release control after readiness seal and preserve state ownership rules before GATE-M14 evaluation.
Promote exactly the candidate identified by the PRODUCTION_READY record without rebuilding, changing configuration, changing migrations or substituting artifacts.
Attempt promotion with any artifact/configuration/source identity different from the production-ready candidate and verify promotion is rejected before deployment mutation.
If post-promotion verification fails, execute the declared production rollback while preserving immutable readiness, promotion and rollback evidence as distinct records.
